guide.title: How to install your eSIM
guide.intro: This guide matches the simplyur website and app flow. You can browse Korea plans today; after checkout and payment go live, your QR arrives by email (and in My eSIM when signed in).
guide.flowPhaseNote: Live now: Korea plans, prices, install guide, and in-app checkout payment.
guide.regionalFaqNote: simplyur Phase 1 is Korea-only. The policy below is kept for when we add multi-region plans — it does not apply to current South Korea eSIM products.
quickSteps: Confirm your phone supports eSIM and is carrier-unlocked.
Connect to stable Wi‑Fi before installing.
Open the QR code from your simplyur email (or My eSIM after sign-in).
Add the eSIM in Settings — scan the QR or enter the manual code.
When you arrive in Korea, turn on the simplyur line and set it as your mobile data.

precheckBlocks.heading: 1. Check device compatibility
paras: Your phone must support eSIM and be unlocked (or eligible for eSIM add-on). See Compatible devices in the menu.
bullets: iPhone XS and newer (including iPhone 14/15/16 series)
Samsung Galaxy S20+, Google Pixel 3+, and other eSIM-capable Android models

precheckBlocks.heading: 2. Use a stable network
paras: Install on trusted Wi‑Fi (hotel, airport lounge, home). Unsecured public Wi‑Fi may cause installation to fail.
precheckBlocks.note: If installation fails, restart your phone and try again on a different network.

precheckBlocks.heading: 3. When to install
paras: Most Korea plans can be installed before you fly. Your usage period typically starts when the eSIM first connects to a network in Korea — check your order email for details.

precheckFaq.q: Can I install before flying to Korea?
precheckFaq.a: Yes for most Korea plans. Install before departure so data works as soon as you land at Incheon or any Korean airport.

precheckFaq.q: Does my phone need to be unlocked?
precheckFaq.a: Yes. Carrier-locked phones cannot add a travel eSIM. Check with your home carrier or try adding any eSIM in Settings to confirm.

bullets: Choose a Korea plan on simplyur → open Checkout.
Enter your email (required — your QR is sent here) and optional phone with country code. Agree to terms and pay.
After payment is confirmed and your eSIM is issued, open the email sent to that address (QR image, SM-DP+ address, activation code).
Optional: Sign in with Google using the same email → My eSIM on the website or app to view QR and data usage.
blocks.note: Keep the QR email until your trip ends. Do not share your activation code publicly.

bullets: End any active phone call before installing.
Stay on Wi‑Fi or cellular data during setup.

blocks.heading: Option A — Scan QR code
paras: iPhone cannot scan a QR saved in your own Photos app. Display the QR on another screen (laptop, tablet, or a travel companion's phone) or print it.
bullets: Open Settings → Cellular (or Mobile Data) → Add eSIM.
Tap Use QR Code and scan the code from your simplyur email.
Follow the on-screen prompts until installation completes.

blocks.heading: Option B — Enter code manually
paras: Use this if the camera cannot scan the QR.
bullets: Open Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM → Enter Details Manually.
Enter the SM-DP+ Address and Activation Code from your simplyur email.
Confirm and wait for the line to download.
Open Settings → Cellular.
Select your new simplyur line and turn it ON.
Set simplyur as your Cellular Data line.
Enable Data Roaming if your plan requires it (see order email).
blocks.note: If data does not connect, toggle Airplane Mode off and on, or manually select a supported network operator.

blocks.heading: Label your plan (optional)
bullets: Settings → Cellular → tap the new plan.
Tap Cellular Plan Label and choose Travel or a custom name such as Korea.

blocks.note: Only remove the eSIM after your trip is fully finished. If you have connection issues, contact simplyur support before deleting the profile.
bullets: Settings → Cellular → select the travel eSIM.
Tap Remove Cellular Plan and confirm.
Choose a plan → Checkout with your email (required) and optional phone.
After payment and issuance, open the QR email sent to that address.
Same email + Google sign-in → My eSIM for QR and usage (when sign-in is enabled).
End any active call before installing.
Connect to Wi‑Fi or mobile data.

blocks.heading: Option A — Scan QR code
bullets: Open Settings → Connections (or Network & Internet).
Tap SIM manager or SIM card manager → Add eSIM.
Scan the QR code from your simplyur email and confirm.

blocks.heading: Option B — Enter code manually
paras: If scanning fails, choose Enter activation code and type the details from your simplyur email.

blocks.note: Menu names vary by manufacturer (Samsung, Google Pixel, etc.). Look for SIM manager or Add eSIM.

bullets: Open SIM manager and ensure the simplyur eSIM is enabled.
Set simplyur as the default line for Mobile data.
Turn on Data roaming if required by your plan.
blocks.note: Toggle Airplane Mode or restart the device if the network does not appear within a few minutes.

bullets: Settings → Connections → SIM manager.
Select the travel eSIM → Delete or Remove.
Confirm removal.
blocks.note: Contact simplyur support before deleting if you still need help with connectivity.

commonFaq.a: You can browse South Korea eSIM plans, pay in the app, follow this install guide, and use My eSIM after sign-in for QR codes, usage, and unused-plan refunds.

commonFaq.q: How does purchase work on simplyur? (when checkout is live)
commonFaq.a: 1) Pick a plan on Find my eSIM. 2) Checkout — email is required (QR is sent here); phone is optional (include country code). 3) Agree to purchase terms. 4) Pay online. 5) After payment is confirmed and the eSIM is issued, you receive an email with QR and manual install codes. No account is required to buy.

commonFaq.q: Do I need to sign in to buy?
commonFaq.a: No. Checkout is guest-based with your email. Sign-in is only for My eSIM (order list, QR, data usage).

commonFaq.q: How does My eSIM and Google sign-in work?
commonFaq.a: My eSIM shows simplyur orders linked to your signed-in account email (Google, Apple, or email/password). Use the same email you enter at checkout. Without sign-in, rely on the QR email.

commonFaq.q: When will I receive my QR code?
commonFaq.a: After payment succeeds and fulfillment completes — usually within a few minutes. The email goes to your checkout address and includes QR (when available), SM-DP+ address, and activation code. My eSIM shows the same once order status is Delivered.
Plan prices on simplyur use the catalog consumer price plus 5%, converted to your selected locale currency with rates refreshed about every 12 hours (en / ja / zh / zh-TW / vi).
No. Coupons are not supported on simplyur checkout.

commonFaq.q: When does my Korea plan start?
commonFaq.a: For most plans, usage starts when the eSIM first connects to a mobile network in South Korea — not necessarily when you install. See your order confirmation email.

commonFaq.q: Can I install at Incheon Airport?
commonFaq.a: Yes. Use airport Wi‑Fi, open your QR email, and add the eSIM in Settings. Many plans allow installation before you land.

commonFaq.q: Roaming network vs local Korean network?
commonFaq.a: Both are Korea-only in Phase 1. Roaming plans often need Data Roaming ON. Local-network plans use a Korean carrier profile directly. Both cover Seoul, Busan, Jeju, and nationwide.

commonFaq.q: Do I need to turn on data roaming?
commonFaq.a: Usually yes for roaming-network plans. Local-network plans may work with roaming OFF; if unstable, try enabling Data Roaming.

commonFaq.q: Can I keep my home SIM for calls and use simplyur for data?
commonFaq.a: Yes on dual-SIM phones. Set simplyur as the mobile data line; keep your home SIM for voice/SMS if needed.

commonFaq.q: Can I transfer my eSIM to another phone?
commonFaq.a: No. Once activated on a device, the profile cannot move to another phone. Purchase a new eSIM if you change devices.

commonFaq.q: Installation failed — what should I try?
commonFaq.a: Restart the phone, use stable Wi‑Fi, end active calls, retry. On iPhone, scan the QR from another screen (not Photos). Email bongtour24@naver.com with your order number if it still fails.
Turn the simplyur line ON, set it as mobile data, toggle Airplane Mode 30 seconds, enable Data Roaming if your plan needs it, or pick a network manually.
Phase 1 products are for use in South Korea only.
Unused eSIMs may be refundable per simplyur terms before activation/first use. Support: bongtour24@naver.com (English OK), KST 09:00–18:00 Mon–Fri. Include order number and phone model.

regionalFaq.q: China mainland activation — plans that include China data (05 code)
regionalFaq.a: Effective 17 June 2026, 00:00 (Beijing time): products that include China mainland data under the 05 code cannot be first activated inside mainland China. Complete activation outside mainland China before entry. Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan count as outside mainland China. Before entering mainland China: insert the eSIM within 72 hours of entry; perform first installation outside mainland China; power on and stay connected to a network for at least 3–5 minutes. Skipping these steps may prevent activation or data service after entry. This notice is for future multi-region plans — not current Korea-only simplyur products.
